title: Almost isoclinic Lagrangian submanifolds
summary: We introduce the almost isoclinic region in the oriented Lagrangian Grassmannian ${\rm Lag}^+(n)$ of $\mathbb{C}^n$, an intrinsic higher-dimensional analog of a natural convex region in ${\rm Lag}^+(2) \simeq \mathbb S^1\times \mathbb S^2$. A Lagrangian submanifold is called almost isoclinic if its Gauss map takes values in this region, extending the graphical condition that the characteristic angles of the tangent plane remain uniformly close. We construct a canonical positive function $Λ$ on this region and prove that $\log Λ$ is concave with respect to the invariant Grassmannian metric.…
